notes.title: Bug Identified
notes.notes:
A bug has been reported when playing as Michelle in the Police Station.

For now until this is fixed (in the next update which should be done within an 30 minutes or so) make sure that you only click on the desk once. Clicking twice causes the end of the world as we know it.

I apologise for any inconvenience and am working as fast as I can to fix this.

notes.title: UPDATE: Sound Issues & Film Grain
notes.notes:
I've updated the game to reduce the film grain in the game as it was rather overwhelming in parts.

I've also reduced the volume level of Mancini's speech as he was louder than he should have been for some reason.

I hope you're all enjoying it so far!

notes.title: Release Date Update
notes.notes:
The game is 99.9% ready but Steam are now saying they need up to 5 working days to review it before it can be made live which unfortunately means there'll be a slight delay in the release date. 

If they finish their review any earlier then it'll be made live ASAP.

Thanks for your patience and understanding.
